title: RBAC + tenant isolation for Usage Insights (route/model dashboards + exports)
creator: Logan Wright
project: In-console usage insights (cost drivers by route)
description:
Goal
Ensure Usage Insights dashboards + export functionality strictly respect org/project boundaries (and deployment mode scoping where applicable). Add test coverage to prevent cross-project data leakage, and complete security review sign-off.

Background / Why
Usage Insights aggregates cost + latency by route/model. Customers will use this for internal chargeback and incident/cost review workflows, and exports are expected to be used in finance pipelines. Any cross-tenant or cross-project leakage is a critical severity issue.

In scope
1) API authorization + query scoping
- Enforce org_id + project_id scoping on all Usage Insights API endpoints:
  - Top routes (list)
  - Route detail (model breakdown + deltas)
  - Export job create + export download
- Ensure scoping is applied in the service layer before query execution (do not rely only on downstream dataset partitioning).
- Ensure request principal is evaluated consistently with existing Console RBAC model:
  - Org role (Owner/Admin/Member/Read-only)
  - Project membership
  - Service accounts (if applicable)
- Ensure deployment mode filters cannot be used to “probe” existence of other projects’ data.

2) Exports
- Export job creation must validate:
  - principal has access to project
  - filters are within allowed bounds (time range, route/model cardinality)
- Export download must re-check authorization (do not rely on “possession of export_id”).
- Ensure audit events capture org/project IDs and are emitted on both create + download.

3) Tests (must catch cross-project leakage)
Add automated tests that simulate:
- Same org, two projects (project A + project B)
  - both have identical route names (e.g., “chat.completions”) and identical model names
  - verify the API returns only the scoped project results
- Two different orgs
  - verify complete isolation (403/404 as appropriate) and no aggregated totals drift
- “Export job ID guessing” / re-use
  - create export in project A, attempt to download as principal from project B => denied
- RBAC role coverage
  - read-only user can view insights
  - non-member cannot view
  - service account w/ limited project access can view only allowed project

4) Security review coordination
- Sync with Naomi Feldman (Security/RBAC product review) + Marcus Lin (Security Eng) + Kevin Osei (Audit logging/export security) to confirm:
  - consistent error semantics (403 vs 404) for non-members
  - required audit fields are present
  - logging does not include sensitive prompt or request payload data

Non-goals
- Building new RBAC primitives or admin UX for Usage Insights.
- Cross-org consolidated reporting.

Acceptance criteria
- All insights endpoints require project-scoped auth; no endpoint can be called with only org scope.
- Export create + download both perform authorization checks (no TOCTOU).
- Automated tests exist and are green in CI, including negative tests for cross-project access.
- Security review comments addressed and written approval noted in ticket.
- Documentation note in API contract: scoping rules + error semantics.

Implementation notes / Risks
- Dataset queries frequently join aggregates by (org_id, project_id, time_bucket, route_normalized, model). Verify all join predicates include org_id and project_id.
- Beware cache keying: any API caching must include org_id + project_id + filters; verify there is no shared cache across tenants.
- For “Unknown route” rollups, ensure the rollup key is per-project (do not aggregate across project because of normalization/hashing collisions).

Links
- Related API work: ENG-8423 (top routes endpoint), ENG-8424 (route detail endpoint), ENG-8425 (export)
- Related PRs (expected/placeholder): PR for RBAC middleware + tests; PR for export download auth re-check

Task breakdown
- [ ] Add auth/tenant-scope enforcement to insights API router + handlers
- [ ] Verify query builder always includes org_id + project_id predicates
- [ ] Add integration tests for cross-project isolation
- [ ] Add export job create/download authorization + negative tests
- [ ] Validate cache key includes principal scope
- [ ] Security review sync + capture approval

Definition of Done
- Merged to main; tests passing; security sign-off recorded; ready for beta gating checklist.
